description: What the NMLS registry reports for one company number that has a published FreeRateUpdate public lender page, exactly as FRU's registry mirror records it: company name, registration status and standing AS RECORDED (never interpreted) from the same registry edition, date formed and years in business, and the public page URL and states the page resolver publishes. Sources are the NMLS mirror tables only. found=false with a reason when there is no published page for the company, or no registry record. No pricing or rate comparison is returned.
name: get_nmls_standing
